title: Get the first 10 customers
summary: CRM up, outbound out, calls qualified, the first invoices sent.

parts.title: Set up a CRM
parts.guidance: Configure the CRM around the initial target customers, sales stages and information needed to qualify a real opportunity. Assign ownership and define what moves a deal forward before importing contacts. Test a sample record and activity history, then give the outbound workflow a usable target list without treating every imported contact as a qualified lead.

parts.title: Run outbound sales sequences
parts.guidance: Use the agreed customer profile and CRM targets to prepare a specific outreach campaign, including the offer, message and follow-up responsibility. Review contact permissions and the intended sending method before authorizing outreach. Record responses, qualification findings and agreed next steps in the CRM; update commercial status when the customer makes a commitment.

parts.title: Send an invoice
parts.guidance: Invoice only against the agreed transaction and the correct customer billing details. Reconcile the products or work supplied, price, currency and payment terms before the billing owner authorizes sending. Link the delivered invoice and subsequent payment to the customer record so the team can see what was purchased, collected and still owed.
